claim: The /book hero cover states the right sizes and gets fetchPriority=high, so phones load the 720w file, not the 1200w
evidence: BookView.tsx:58-64: sizes '(min-width: 1024px) 400px, (min-width: 560px) 40vw, 220px', loading eager, fetchPriority high. Measured (m-mob.json): at 360 DPR 3 the 220x275 slot loads khous-cover-b-720.webp (133 KB), requested at 702 ms at High; at 1440 (m-desk.json) also 720w for the 400 px slot.

claim: First-screen images that are likely the LCP (journal lead card, store grid first cards, product cover) are no longer lazy
evidence: journal/page.tsx:53-54 eager + high; store/page.tsx:52 `loading={i < 2 ? 'eager' : 'lazy'}`; store/[slug]/page.tsx:80-81 eager + high. Measured: /journal LCP image requested at 633 ms (High). The same defect class recurs on /shelf's door photo, which X7.2 did not list (PERF-03).

claim: check:budgets fails when out/ has no public page instead of passing on Math.max of an empty list
evidence: check-budgets.mjs:47-51 exits 1 on an empty page list, 84-88 exits 1 when a page has no /_next/static script, 71-74 exits 1 when a referenced chunk is missing. `node scripts/check-budgets.mjs` on today's export: 24 pages, OK largest 148.9 KiB.

claim: page-flip's requestAnimationFrame loop stops after destroy()
evidence: patches/page-flip@2.0.7.patch makes the loop `const t=e=>{this.stopped||(this.render(e),requestAnimationFrame(t))}` and destroy() set `this.render.stopped=!0`; the exported lazy chunk out/_next/static/chunks/3y7oy_tt71u1t.js carries both (grep). PdfBookReader.tsx:449 calls flip.destroy() on teardown.

claim: A PDF document that finishes loading after the reader closed is destroyed with its worker
evidence: PdfBookReader.tsx:171 `(result) => (live ? setLoaded(result) : void result.doc.loadingTask.destroy())`, :179 destroys the loaded one on change/unmount; pdf.ts:44-45 destroys a failed load's task. Static check only.

claim: public/media/manifest.json totalBytes matches the films it lists
evidence: After D44 restored the five films: 18 entries, sum of `bytes` 58,588,162 = totalBytes 58,588,162 = the 18 files on disk (node check).

claim: checkout.html is at 148.9 of the 150 KiB public budget
evidence: check-budgets on today's export: checkout.html 148.9 KiB (10 scripts), the largest; my own gzip of its HTML-referenced chunks gives the same. The figure leaves out Turnstile's api.js that the checkout form loads at mount (PERF-01).
